chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) concerning the righteous among his companions
As for the righteous, they are those who do not fear for their souls nor grieve over what has passed
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali define the spiritual state of the righteous companions?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes the righteous among his companions by their inner peace and detachment from anxiety about their own selves and regret over past events. This description reflects the Shia concept of *sakinah* (tranquility) as a divine gift for those who maintain steadfastness (*thabat*) in faith amidst the trials of leadership. Such spiritual stability is viewed as a prerequisite for effective governance and spiritual purity in the Imami tradition.
